# Felinids
Felinids have claws that deal slash damage in melee combat and a distinctive "feline" accent. They have night vision that can be toggled on and off. They can lick their wounds, helping to stop bleeding and speed up recovery.
Their defenses differ slightly from those of standard humanoids: they take [color=#ffa500]10% more blunt, slash, and piercing damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]10% more heat damage[/color], but [color=#1e90ff]10% less cold damage[/color].
Felinids are compact enough to fit inside a bag when necessary.
